package_notes: RA execution freeze: Gemini scientific contract + ChatGPT machine schema. Primary scientific metric remains Gemini median_delta_distance; ChatGPT reports median_R decision as tooling output.

primary_metric.name: median_delta_distance
primary_metric.tooling_alias: median_R = D_c / max(1, median(D_u)); lower R is better carrier

search_band.definition: Closed interval [anchor, reset_endpoint] of the immediate lower chamber preceding isqrt(N)

statistics.test: one-sided exact sign test on delta = control_median_D_u - D_c

decision_rule.gemini_text: Reject H0 if p < 0.05 and median_delta_distance > 0

reporting_allowed_after_run: measured on hold-out corpus C with N cases
